root.name: ユナイテッド・セラピューティクス

rows.ja: 製造委託・技術の提供元
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 吸入薬Tyvaso DPIの製造をMannKindに全面的に委託(供給契約)
relations.text_en: Relies entirely on MannKind to manufacture Tyvaso DPI under a supply agreement

source.label: United Therapeutics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We currently rely entirely on MannKind to manufacture Tyvaso DPI finished drug product and inhalers.

relations.text: 皮下注射ポンプRemunityをDEKAと共同開発し、DEKAの関連会社が製造・供給
relations.text_en: Co-developed the Remunity pump with DEKA, whose affiliate manufactures and supplies it

source.label: United Therapeutics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In November 2019, we entered into a supply agreement with an affiliate of DEKA to manufacture and supply the Remunity Pump to us.

relations.text: 自社の製剤技術の利用権を与え、Orenitramの開発に使われた
relations.text_en: Licensed its drug-delivery technology, used in developing Orenitram for United Therapeutics

source.label: Supernus 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Orenitram (developed for United Therapeutics Corporation); and Namzaric (developed for Allergan plc).

relations.text: 肺動脈性肺高血圧症向けAdcircaの米国販売権をリリーから取得(価格はリリーが設定)
relations.text_en: Acquired US rights to Adcirca for PAH from Lilly in 2008; Lilly sets its prices

source.label: United Therapeutics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We acquired the commercial rights to Adcirca for the treatment of PAH in the United States from Lilly in 2008.

source.label: United Therapeutics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In December 2023, we acquired Miromatrix Medical Inc.

source.label: United Therapeutics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In October 2023, we completed the acquisition of IVIVA Medical, Inc.

companies.name: ベータ・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: 臓器輸送などに使う電動航空機の民間顧客の一社がUnited Therapeutics
relations.text_en: United Therapeutics is one of its civil aircraft customers

source.label: BETA Technologies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our current civil aircraft customers include UPS, United Therapeutics, Air New Zealand, Bristow and Metro Air Services.

relations.text: Liquidiaが10-Kで、自社のトレプロスチニル注射剤の主な競合としてUnited TherapeuticsのRemodulinを挙げる
relations.text_en: Liquidia names United Therapeutics' Remodulin as the main competition for its treprostinil injection

source.label: Liquidia 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our Treprostinil Injection product to treat PAH faces competition primarily from the continued use of the branded Remodulin sold by United Therapeutics

relations.text: Gossamerが10-Kで、PH-ILDの競合としてUnited TherapeuticsのTyvasoを挙げる
relations.text_en: Gossamer names United Therapeutics' Tyvaso as competition in PH-ILD

source.label: Gossamer Bio 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We expect to face competition from Tyvaso (United Therapeutics) and Yutrepia (Liquidia) within the PH-ILD indication

companies.name: アラウノス・セラピューティクス

relations.text: Alaunosが、承認されれば競合する肺動脈性肺高血圧症の治療薬の会社としてUnited Therapeuticsを挙げる
relations.text_en: Alaunos names United Therapeutics among PAH therapy makers its candidates would compete with

source.label: Alaunos Therapeutics 10-Q(2026年第3四半期)
source.quote: our product candidates would compete with approved therapies across the endothelin, nitric oxide and prostacyclin pathways, marketed by companies including United Therapeutics

companies.name: ピュアテック・ヘルス

relations.text: PureTechが年次報告で、競合しうる開発品としてUnited Therapeuticsのトレプロスチニルを挙げる
relations.text_en: PureTech names United Therapeutics' treprostinil among potentially competing candidates

source.label: PureTech Health 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: United Therapeutics' treprostinil in Phase 3 clinical trials
